Name: Milk Allergen
scope: Milk and dairy derivatives containing allergenic casein or whey proteins

Name: Eggs Allergen
scope: Eggs from domestic poultry and egg protein derivatives

Name: Peanuts Allergen
scope: Peanuts (Arachis hypogaea) and peanut protein ingredients

Name: Tree nuts Allergen
scope: Tree nuts (almond, walnut, pecan, cashew, hazelnut, macadamia, etc.)

Name: Wheat Allergen
scope: Wheat species (genus Triticum) containing gluten and non-gluten allergenic proteins

Name: Fish Allergen
scope: Finfish species (e.g., cod, haddock, flounder, salmon, trout)

Name: Crustacean shellfish Allergen
scope: Crustacean shellfish (e.g., crab, lobster, shrimp, prawn)

Name: Sesame Allergen
scope: Sesame seeds (Sesamum indicum) and sesame protein ingredients
